A [[Rodian]] '''individual''' worked as an [[Aide|assistant]] of [[Colonel]] [[Tuttle]] of [[New Republic]] [[Requisitions]].<ref name="Chapter 21" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Rodian assistant first appeared in "[[Chapter 21: The Pirate]]," the twenty-first episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which was directed by [[Peter Ramsey]]. [[Dawn Dininger]] portrayed the character.<ref name="Chapter 21" />
